newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index eases in moderate trading.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index eases in moderate trading.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index eased marginally in moderate trading on Thursday, bourse officials said. The index shed 7.47 points to close at 3366.68.
Turnover was posted at 17.266 million shillings on 467,892 shares compared to 18.100 million shillings on 469,872 shares on Wednesday.
Brokers said there had been a shift from the heavy trading in blue chips seen last week to cheaper shares, not index-linked.
Tourism Promotion Services which is the trading name for recently floated Serena Lodges & Hotels was the main focus of activity.
A total of 95,019 shares traded at 18.50 from 18.60.
Demand was mainly from corporate investors who were disappointed to receive just 640 shares at the conclusion of the share offer in April.
Uchumi Supermarket edged to 41.75 from 41.50 while Standard Newspapers Group closed at 14.05 from 14.
Rea Vipingo eased to 8.95 from 9 while Sasini Tea & Coffee was unchanged at 76.
Kenya Commercial Bank closed at 94 unchanged while Standard Chartered Bank closed at 46 unchanged.
Kenya Power & Lighting gained a shilling to close at 133 from 132 while Total Kenya shed a shilling to close at 166.
The Central Bank of Kenya floating rate treasury bonds traded 700,000 shillings at between 103.0000 percent and 103.3494 percent compared to 103.0000 percent on Wednesday.
